description: This file contains functions for managing environment configurations, command-line arguments, and file-based locking mechanisms for executing local heavy checks in a Node.js environment. It includes logic for applying policies, acquiring and releasing file locks, and handling process ownership and stale lock detection.

methods.name: isLocalCheckEnabled
methods.description: Determines if local check is enabled based on environment variables, specifically evaluating 'OPENCLAW_LOCAL_CHECK'.

methods.name: hasFlag
methods.description: Checks if a given argument list contains a specific flag or a flag with a value.

methods.name: applyLocalTsgoPolicy
methods.description: Applies specific environment and argument modifications for local TypeScript Go policy if local check is enabled.

methods.name: applyLocalOxlintPolicy
methods.description: Applies specific environment and argument modifications for local Oxlint policy if local check is enabled.

methods.name: acquireLocalHeavyCheckLockSync
methods.description: Synchronously attempts to acquire a lock for local heavy checks, creating lock files and handling stale or orphaned locks.

methods.name: resolveGitCommonDir
methods.description: Resolves the common Git directory for the given working directory by invoking 'git rev-parse --git-common-dir'.
